Smart toilets combine technology, culture, personal hygiene, and bathing habits, whilst offering the perfect balance of form, function, and comfort to encapsulate the essence of the modern toilet.

Bidets have been a bathroom fixture for over 300 years, emerging from France in the 1700s. The modern smart toilet has taken traditional bidets to a new level by integrating the bidet into the toilet suite and adding high-tech luxury features. Australians have embraced smart technology in our phones, homes, watches & televisions - smart toilets provide a new opportunity to enhance the bathroom by incorporating the latest smart technology.
